tools.description: Search GlobalWay’s guides for brands selling abroad and the creators they work with: sponsorship prices on YouTube, Instagram and X, finding creators, selling without an overseas store, Amazon Brand Registry and Attribution, and more. Returns the best matches, each with its title, summary and page U

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List every GlobalWay guide with its summary and link.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The full text of one guide as Markdown, with its source URL and review date at the end. Prices in it come from the same tables the site’s estimators use.

tools.name: list_niches
tools.description: The content niches (IAB category ids) the estimators price by, with English and Chinese names.

tools.name: estimate_post_price
tools.description: Advisory price range for one sponsored post on a YouTube, X or Instagram channel, from its reach and niche, using GlobalWay’s per-1,000 rates. tools.name: estimate_budget_reach
tools.description: For a per-post budget in USD, roughly how many views (YouTube), impressions (X) or followers of the account booked (Instagram) it buys, at GlobalWay’s rates. Advisory.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide · Public sink: estimate_post_price, estimate_budget_reach.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide · Public sink: estimate_post_price, estimate_budget_reach

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
